notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
Day-Night selection during sleep is now possible
Added more icons during the lesson
Artificial intelligence improvements
Added mission sound
Added interfaces to identify chapters
Added dialog selection animations
Game notifications have been edited
Map changes have been made. Reduced the walking area, added a new path
Increased number of NPCs
And Bug-Fix

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
GAME MECHANICS 

    Added chalk throwing during class.
    Added chalk throwing during the exam.
    Bodyguard added. (strong and weak)
    Man fighting bet added.
    Added random money drops when you beat people
Bodyguard added.

 APPEARANCE and UI 

    Added sound to the game start button.
    Start game animation added.
    Casino lighting organized.
    Emojis were added for students who made noise and were silenced.

 SOUND 

    Effect sounds have been added for correct and incorrect lecturing.
    Added escape sounds for female NPCs
     Gunfire added to early finale

 BUG AND FIX

    Animation fixes.
    Car sounds fix.
    Regulation of changes in honor and relationships
    Lesson Fix
